# Project Germany

> Educational consultancy guiding international students to study in German public universities with university applications, student visas, accommodation, and relocation assistance.

## Overview
Project Germany is a specialized educational consultancy founded by alumni of the German higher education system. We provide comprehensive, personalized support for international students seeking admission into tuition-free and low-tuition public universities in Germany.

## Core Services
- **University Selection**: Academic profiling and tailored shortlisting of German public university programs that match student goals.
- **Application Assistance**: Complete document verification, VPD / Uni-Assist guidance, and motivation letter structuring adhering to German academic standards.
- **Student Visa Support**: Step-by-step guidance through the German student visa process, blocked account setup, health insurance selection, and embassy interview preparation.
- **Accommodation Guidance**: Pre-arrival placement assistance for student dormitories (Studentenwerk) and private student housing across German cities.
- **German Language Courses**: Connections to accredited German language academies from beginner A1 to university entry level (C1 / TestDaF / DSH).
- **Career & Post-Study Guidance**: Practical advice on working rights (Werkstudent jobs) and navigating the 18-month post-study residence permit for job seekers in Germany.
